purpose: Retrieve a common August atmospheric reference for Tolima and its screening grid so that the 2026 episode can be situated against a long meteorological baseline independently of GWIS historical event availability.

excluded_variable.name: total_precipitation
excluded_variable.reason: ERA5 Land precipitation requires a separately audited accumulation reconstruction and is not part of this atmospheric reference request.

time_coverage: Every hourly valid time from August 1 00 UTC through August 31 23 UTC for each year.

spatial_request.rule: Exactly the established ERA5 Land Tolima screening grid.

retrieval_partition.rule: One raw GRIB file per year
retrieval_partition.reason: A previous combined five-year request exceeded the service request-size limit. One-year files permit auditable coverage and recovery from a failed request.

future_comparison_rule: The climatological baseline and the five GWIS-eligible historical seasons are separate comparators. Seasonal atmospheric ranks and deviations may be reported. Neither permits causal attribution or a homogeneous wildfire occurrence trend.
prohibited_interpretations: mixing GWIS event counts across years as a calibration target
using precipitation before a separate climatology retrieval and audit
